Practical information

The essentials to know before you arrive.

🧾

City tax

€2.50 per person per night, payable at the riad. It is charged by the city of Marrakech and is not included in the room rate.

💵

Paying for extras

All extras and services you book (transfer, dinner, cooking class, excursions, hammam, extra breakfast) are paid on site in cash.

📍

Address of the riad

191 Derb Dabachi, Rue Derb Jdid — Médina, Marrakech 40040. The lane is pedestrian only, so your driver drops you at the nearest entrance.

Get directions
🕚

Check-out

Check-out time is stated in your booking confirmation. We keep your luggage free of charge if your flight or train is later.

🌙

Late arrival or delayed flight

Let us know on WhatsApp: someone will be waiting for you, whatever the time.

Book your services

Open a service to read everything and book it without leaving this page. Everything is paid on site in cash, except group excursions which are paid online.

Private excursions

From 45 € per person depending on the destination

 ⌄

Agafay, Ourika, Essaouira, the Atlas mountains, Ouzoud… in a private car with driver, leaving from the riad at your own pace.

  • Agafay desert, Ourika valley, Essaouira, Atlas mountains and Berber valleys, Ouzoud waterfalls.
  • Private car with driver, leaving from the riad at the time you choose.
  • Full or half day, itinerary adapted to your own pace.
  • Quote sent within a few hours depending on the destination and the number of people.
  • The price per person goes down as the group grows: the total appears as soon as you pick the destination and the number of people.
